verdict.rationale: AI-drafted remediation pull requests are a fair capability to ask of a security scanner, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows Gitleaks detecting secrets and gitleaks-action commenting on PRs or alerting users. Nothing shows AI-generated fixes or remediation PRs, and PR comments are an adjacent feature that earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI draft remediation pull requests for security findings that I review and merge
